paragraphs: An ordering and inventory system for Sib's Trading, a raw chicken and chicken by-products business. Customers browse stock and place orders. The admin manages stock, orders and customers.
The whole app is one file: sibs-trading.html (plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript, no framework, no build step). It runs in one of two modes:
Before cloud mode works you must follow FIREBASESETUP.md (publish the rules in database.rules.json, enable sign-in, create the admin account). Never leave the database in test mode.
features: One login page for customers and admin. After logging in, the system decides the role: admin goes to the Admin dashboard, customers go to the Shop.

Cloud mode: sign-in uses Firebase Authentication (email and password). The role comes from the database: only user IDs listed under /admins (which only you can edit, in the Firebase console) are admins. A customer…
Forgot password (cloud): sends a real reset email. Admin can also send a customer a reset email.

One login per browser: every tab of the same browser shares the same login. Opening the site in a second tab opens the account that is already logged in; a login page left open in another tab switches to it as soon as…

Automatic log out: after 12 hours with no click or key press (in any tab) the person is logged out and asked to log in again. This only applies when the app is opened again after that long; logging in again always works…
